[3106] Military Medicine The structure, functions, and dynamics of modern aircraft and submarines has evolved quickly

[3107] Phenomena such as high and low altitude pressures, temperature changes, acceleration, spatial disorientation, noise and vibration can easily exceed the limits of human biology

[3108] Therefore, aviation and diving medicine, which are exclusive of military medicine and closely linked to the enhancement of combat strength in the frontline, have become two of the major focuses of military medical research institutions

[3109] Maintaining the physical and mental health of aviation and diving personnel is the undoubted mission of aviation and diving medicine

[3110] The selection, health care, task safety, accident investigation, and the promotion of overall research systems all depend on the efforts of specialized medical staff

[3111] Their efforts guaranteed the safety of flight tasks, the realization of submarine missions, the control of quality, and the increase of combat power

[3112] Diving medicine study ensuring the safety of underwater operations. Aviation physiological training readiness: Gangshan Armed Forces Hospital is a well-equipped aviation physiological training center and the basis of flight training for pilots

[3113] Established on July 1st, 2002, the aviation biological training equipment in the hospital includes Ejection Seat, Spatial Disorientation Aircraft and Night Vision/Night Vision Goggles Systems along with the original equipment of the Human Body Centrifugal Machine, the High Pressure Cabin and the Low Pressure Cabin

[3114] Improving aviation psychology training of the pilots: "Training Standards of Aviation Medicine" was amended and implemented on May

[3115] c. Developing aviation physiology officers: The Training Plan for Aviation Physiology Officers of the ROC Armed Forces was issued on December 18th, 2003 so as to reinforce the operation of aviation medicine

[3116] The aviation physiology officer is in charge of physiological training

[3117] He also supervises the availability of flight personnel equipment and life support equipment

[3118] Physical examination of flight personnel: In addition to the annual physical examination, a "Procedure of Applying for Examination Result and Appealing for Reexamination" for those who cannot pass the examination is proposed to validate the physical fitness of flight personnel

[3119] Promoting "Submarine Medicine" a. The Navy Headquarters Military Medicine Section, the Submarine Medical Research Graduate School at National Defense Medical College, the Penghu Armed Forces Hospital and related units and personnel are organized as a task force subordinate to the MND to promote the development of "Submarine Medicine

[3120] The MND has formulated task forces to visit submarines, rescue groups, and the Diving Medicine Unit of Zuoying Armed Forces Hospital so as to understand how submariners work in closed space, as well as the operational procedures and available equipment of the deep-water rescue groups

[3121] Seminars with related personnel were also held

[3122] It is hoped that basic medical practices can be realized, problems can be solved, and the research and development of diving medicine can be facilitated

[3123] Starting from 2004, in order to provide high quality safety measures to naval servicemen on duty, the MND has prepared a budget to enhance the equipment (high-pressure chamber at Zuoying Armed Forces Hospital as an example) maintenance measures and the depth and scope of the diving medicine so as to strengthen the medical care and training capacity provided

[3124] Disposing of Biochemical Poisons In compliance with the Measures of Prevention and Rescue from the Calamity of Bio-chemical Poisons stipulated by Executive Yuan, the MND conducts regional detection and prevention measures to block out terrorists and others with harmful intentions to spread biological viruses in urban area schools, hospitals, water sources, barracks and crowded public areas and otherwise cause serious casualty

[3125] Upon an outbreak, the Executive Yuan will establish the Disaster Management Center and authorize local authorities and the Center for Disease Control of the Department of Health to inspect the pathogeny

[3126] The ROC Armed Forces will respond to the request of the Disaster Management Center to provide sampling and investigating support, and to report to the command center in time once the pathogeny and scope of contamination are confirmed

[3127] According to the scope of contamination and the level of break out, a local disaster relief commander shall command subordinate police units and coordinate with the operational center of the ROC Armed Forces to control the epidemic area

[3128] The basic sanitation units of the Armed Forces shall organize and establish ambulance stations in their respective operational sectors and provide support to health authorities

[3129] Military hospitals of all echelons outside the epidemic areas shall cooperate with the Department of Health, establish emergency medical teams, and acquire necessary medicine and sanitary equipment in support of hospitals in the epidemic area and their practice of biological medical protection operations

[3130] Immunization of the uninfected in epidemic areas is the responsibility of local health departments

[3131] Military dispensaries and hospitals will support the inoculation efforts

[3132] According to infected medical waste disposal procedures, such waste will be burned nearby by specific agencies

[3133] Human remains in the epidemic areas will be registered at the social welfare departments and after completion of decontamination processes, cremated locally

[3134] Infected animals will be exterminated and burned by agriculture and forestry units in coordination with the Armed Forces

[3135] Chemical warfare units will also cooperate with local command centers to conduct decontamination operations

[3136] Vision Constantly acquiring budget allocations and improving the quality of medical care for servicemen It is the responsibility of the military medical system to take good care of all servicemen's health

[3137] In order to provide high-quality medical treatment and to increase the capacity of providing these treatments, the MND shall continually acquire budget allocations to subsidize servicemen's medical bills and to improve the software and hardware facilities of the medical system

[3138] Realizing the system of area of responsibility (AOR) in the local medical system and fulfilling the medical needs of all servicemen a. General hospitals in each operational sector will be the coordinators of their respective areas of responsibility

[3139] A regional small-scale strategic alliance will be established to facilitate the function of mutual support among medical resources, management strategies, and information networks

[3140] Moreover, the Tri-Service General Hospital will establish partnerships with all operational sectors to construct a complete strategic alliance among all medical facilities of the ROC Armed Forces

[3141] b. General hospitals in their respective areas of responsibility will not only provide medical services, but also supervise and support the sanitation operations and requirements of troops of all echelons thereby establishing a complete medical support system

[3142] Reinforcing educational training of the military medicine education, and ensuring the combat readiness of the ROC Armed Forces a. To ensure the operational capabilities of pilots and to fulfill the requirements of fighters of the new generation, the MND will continue evaluating the current field manuals and policies of aviation medicine, consolidating training equipment, reinforcing preventive medicine of the pilot, and providing appropriate flight health care services so as to increase flight safety and maintain combat capability

[3143] In response to the upgrade of the second-generation vessels and the procurement of the Kidd-class destroyer and submarines, the MND will maintain and enhance the training and equipment of diving medicine to ensure the safety of naval personnel operating at sea or underwater and to enforce the combat capability of naval vessels

[3144] Developing Servicemen's Knowledge about Biological Protection, and Increasing the Ability of Biological Poison Disposal In order to promote the ROC Armed Forces' capabilities of biological protection prevention and medical disposal, the MND will continue to strengthen biological protection abilities; to conduct related medical treatment for all military hospitals and sanitation troops; to open biological protection training courses; to develop seed trainers; to proactively conduct research and development, and to procure related medicines, sanitary equipment, and vaccines

[3145] Thus, the operational effectiveness of biological protection medicine can be realized

[3146] The main purposes of rebuilding old military dependent quarters are to improve the living environment and quality of the deteriorated dependent quarters, to increase the economic efficacy of the land and tax income, to solve land disputes, to boom economy, to create job opportunities, to acquire public land for local governments, to beautify urban landscape, and to achieve a "three win" situation among the government, the public and the military dependents of the quarters

[3147] Policy The rebuilding project of military dependent quarters started from 1980 and can be divided into two stages, the "old system" and the "new system

[3148] The old system refers to the "Operation Guidance of the Experimentation Plan for Rebuilding Deteriorated Military Dependents Quarters" approved by the Executive Yuan in

[3149] Current policy is to complete the rebuilding project which had been approved by the Executive Yuan before Feb

[3150] There will be no more rebuilding project following the old system after 2006 and the loan for officers and NCOs with dependents but no housing will be continued and expanded

[3151] The new system follows the "Regulation of Rebuilding Deteriorated Military Dependent Quarters" enacted on February 5th

[3152] Current policy is to launch a joint project of "building housing, assisting in buying public housing or private housing

[3153] The contracting, relocating and marketing tasks will be finished by 2005 and the rebuilding process will be complete by 2009 so as to protect the rights of military dependent householders

[3154] Rebuilding Dependent Quarters through the Old System Seventy-eight rebuilding projects had been approved by the Executive Yuan by February 5th

[3155] Among them, sixty-nine have been finished or relocated; two have been relocated in housing in the market; and the other 7 projects are under planning and construction

[3156] Rebuilding Dependent Quarters through the New System a. Project

[3157] By November 1996, 161 rebuilding projects had been approved by the Executive Yuan, but were revised to 88 projects total in August 2004 with 53 rebuilding projects and 35 relocation projects

[3158] b. Policy: The rebuilding policy in 1997 was "rebuilding exclusively," and was then changed into "cutting down rebuilding projects and assisting with relocating in public housing" in June

[3159] By December 2003 the new policy was further revised to a joint project of "building housing, assisting in buying public housing or private housing

[3160] c. Practice: Among the 88 rebuilding projects planned, 70,815 households from 538 villages need to be settled

[3161] So far, 49,044 households have been relocated

[3162] a) Building new housing: 11 projects have been completed; 20 are under construction; and 4 are underway to apply for building permits

[3163] There is a total authorization of 35 projects, with 25,947 households from 219 villages to be settled

[3164] b) Relocating to public housing and private housing: Residents of 23,097 households for 168 villages in 19 dependent quarters have been relocated, of which 9 have been relocated in public housing or other rebuilt dependent quarters

[3165] d. Follow-up plan: Except for the 9 villages in Lecyun Village in Kaohsiung County and another 39 villages elsewhere, the rebuilding and relocation of all villages throughout Taiwan has been planned in accordance with the intention of the respective village or household, determined after holding statutory conferences with them

[3166] All conferences were held by December

[3167] Rebuilding project: 14,815 households of 84 villages will be settled in the 18 rebuilding sites under construction

[3168] b) Relocating and buying public and private housing: Residents of 26 dependent quarters are encouraged to buy the remaining 6,956 households of 67 public housing villages

[3169] e. Control and Plan of the Rebuilding Fund (a) Fund control: The special budget for the rebuilding of old military dependent quarters was computed according to the government assessed land price of the quarters rebuilt in 1996, with an adjustment of roughly 10.4% each year (accumulated

[3170] The annual revenue is NTD516.7 billion and the annual expenditure is NTD516.6 billion

[3171] Due to the depression in the real estate market, the government-assessed land price of the quarters rebuilt has decreased year after year

[3172] Taking the government-assessed land price in 2004 as the base and added up an additional 30% to the residential and commercial areas (without accumulation), the estimated value of land owned by the MND is around NTD362 billion

[3173] Due to decreased land value, the rebuilding efforts of the MND now focus more on acquiring public or private housing instead of building new quarters

[3174] Therefore, the estimated expenditure of rebuilding old dependent quarters will be around NTD268.4 billion

[3175] Fund Plan

[3176] The value of assets (including interest of the fund and gains from selling the land and remaining houses) is estimated around NTD415.9 billion

[3177] The expense for rebuilding projects is about NTD268.4 billion

[3178] After returning the NTD73.2 billion working fund of unsuitable building sites, the final balance of the rebuilding fund will be around NTD74.3 billion

[3179] Living quality of servicemen and their dependents improved substantially through the rebuilding of military dependent quarters

[3180] In response to possible fund insufficiency after including the option of acquiring public and private housing, the total budget of the rebuilding project for FY 2004 and 2005 as approved by the Executive Yuan in September 2004 is NTD22.7 billion

[3181] With efficient funding, the rebuilding project can be efficiently realized and the rights of military dependents can be protected

[3182] Home Loans and Promotion of the Remaining Houses To increase the living quality of dependents of voluntary officers and NCOs, a more comprehensive home loan project for active officers and NCOs was put into practice and the annual interest rate was decreased to 2.125% in line with the Home Loan Interest Rate Standard for Servicemen, Civil Servants and Teachers

[3183] In 2004, 2,500 loans were approved

[3184] Servicemen with less than 5-year service experience were eligible for the first time as well

[3185] As for the distribution and promotion of the remaining houses, buyers will not only get a 20% discount, but also be eligible for home loans

[3186] In this manner, housing shall be more affordable to officers and NCOs

[3187] During 2002 and 2003, 453 cases were filed through phone, and 582 cases were filed through written forms (including emails

[3188] A total of 54 conferences and 87 public hearings were held

[3189] All 1,176 cases, conferences, and hearings were registered and replied in written form or orally

[3190] Vision: Rebuilding Projects Following Both the New and Old Systems

[3191] For those rebuilding projects with complete plans, the MND will expedite the processes of selecting architects and requesting building permits

[3192] For those under construction, progress and quality control, scandal prevention, and on schedule completion, will be the foci

[3193] For those villages which will be relocated to public housing, the MND will ensure a successful lot-drawing on time so as to facilitate the relocating progress and to comfort the dependents

[3194] Loosening the Eligibility of Home Loan for Officers and NCOs At the end of the allocation and promotion efforts of the housing still remaining from rebuilding projects in 2004, the MND plans to submit a special report to the Executive Yuan suggesting to loosen the eligibility of application for home loans regardless of rank

[3195] The loan per household will be NTD2.2 million with an even lower annual interest rate than currently offered (2.125% as current rate

[3196] It is expected to reach the goal of everybody owning a house

[3197] Implications To achieve the goal of the "three assurances" policy, the MND has continually improved the quality of life of servicemen, constructed a comfortable environment, and has taken good care of them and their dependents

[3198] It is expected to achieve the goals of morale stabilization and family cohesion

[3199] Furthermore, in accordance with national policy and troop requirements, the MND requests units of all levels to carry out the following measures: creating high quality of life, increasing work efficiency of the servicemen, and maintaining the stabilization of the military family so as to achieve cohesion and increase the overall combat capability of the ROC Armed Forces

[3200] The Legalization of Welfare a. To enhance servicemen's welfare and reassure their families, the MND has drafted the "Act of Welfare for Military Personnel" based on the stipulation of the National Defense Law

[3201] It is hoped that an operational mechanism for the welfare affairs of military personnel can be established through legislative procedure and thereby become legally guaranteed

[3202] The draft of the "Act of Welfare for Military Personnel" divides military welfare into two categories, basic and flexible welfare

[3203] Basic welfare is intended for all servicemen and is administrated by the MND

[3204] Items in this category include job placement, welfare services, housing subsidies and medical care

[3205] Flexible welfare will be practiced in line with the requirements of the MND and other authorities

[3206] Items in this category include daycare and preschool, commissary management, and recreational services and facilities

[3207] Non-staple Food Supply a. Providing good food is a real-life practice of fulfilling the living requirements of the servicemen

[3208] Currently, there are 28 non-staple food supply stations serving 1,436 non-staple food items at 20% off market price

[3209] In addition, to improve the cooking techniques of the chefs, the MND has also offered recipes of non-staple food to troop units with the hope of increasing the quality of the mess and satisfying the appetites of the servicemen

[3210] To solve the non-staple food procurement problem of units in mountain and remote areas, the MND has developed the "Non-staple Food Outsourcing Transportation Service for the Units in Mountain and Remote Areas

[3211] There are a total of 24 transportation lines serving 104 remote units in Penghu, Green Island, Hsiao Liuchiu, Hehuanshan, Alishan, Leshan and Dahanshan

[3212] Reward and Consolation a. In order to provide high-quality living care to the military servicemen and offer support in contingency, the MND will process timely subsidies for hospitalized military servicemen or those killed or injured on duty

[3213] The intention is to actively explore the problems the servicemen face and provide timely support and consolation so as to inspire morale and cohesiveness

[3214] On holidays such as Chinese Lunar New Year, Dragon Boat Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival, the MND will express their appreciation for the sacrifice of the troops on offshore islets, mountains and remote areas so as to consolidate the morale of the troops and to increase combat capability

[3215] Facility Improvement a. To take care of the life of the E-generation servicemen, and to provide appropriate recreation and books, the MND has annually conducted market surveys and questionnaires of all servicemen as the basis of acquiring high-tech digital recreational facilities for political education, including video, audio and multimedia recreational devices, and set up multi-purpose recreational centers and information stations

[3216] Therefore, a variety of lively recreational options, including birthday parties, military song instruction, and group recreation can be provided

[3217] In this manner not only the practical measures of political education can be met, but the multimedia recreation needs of servicemen can be provided as well

[3218] The selection and procurement of the "books for company or equivalent units" was achieved through the procedures of recommendation, survey, and trial reading

[3219] The education level of the servicemen was also a consideration

[3220] The books elected include best-selling recreation, inspirational, comic, travel, and technology books

[3221] In addition to carrying the "Voice of Han Broadcasting Network," the "Educational Network of Jyuguang Program," "Special Exhibition on the Military Art Awards" and the "Military News Web," the website of the ROC Armed Forces lists a job counseling and living guide, varied laws and regulations and some digital versions of approved "books for company or equivalent units" so as to provide fast and diverse reading materials and information services

[3222] The satisfaction of recreational requirements and spiritual life will contribute to humanistic developments, which, in turn, will be beneficial to boost morale and decrease cases of discipline violation

[3223] To expedite the rebuilding of old military barracks and to improve the living quality of all servicemen, the newly constructed barracks and facilities are planned under the principle of integrated functions, security and practicability, comfort, and economy

[3224] All barracks follow the procedure of outsourcing to architects, who will then be in charge of the design and oversee the construction

[3225] By doing so, we can combine civilian resources and professions with the national defense establishment

[3226] Furthermore, in order to increase the living quality of the servicemen, a through review concerning the principles of barrack planning and design was conducted

[3227] As a result, living space for every serviceman was increased, and the comprehensive design of the facilities shall be pleasing, and pleasing, combined with the neighborhood, and shall follow the principles of green architecture and environmentally sound construction

[3228] The space design shall facilitate human nature and shall be capable of performing multiple purposes

[3229] The material selection principles are safe, practical and endurable

[3230] The "three assurances" policy of the President Chen Shui-bian ensures the welfare for all servicemen and their dependents

[3231] The Minister of National Defense Lee Jye inspires the morale of all servicemen

[3232] To achieve the "three assurances" policy, to ensure the welfare of all servicemen and their dependents, and to encourage the voluntary officers and NCOs to focus on their duty, the MND has offered selective officer's quarters to voluntary officers and NCOs with dependents but no housing

[3233] The quarters provided shall be in the same county as the one in which the troops are stationed

[3234] There are a total of 6,165 quarters in 81 locations throughout the island

[3235] In the future, the building of selective officer's quarters will be coordinated with the rebuilding projects of old military dependent quarters, the donation from the ROC Women's Association, and the construction of new barracks as well

[3236] Commodity Supply The driving principles of commodity supply are self-sufficiency, large-quantity with lower price, discount price, and profit-return

[3237] Currently, there are 32 regional commissaries and 146 barrack commissaries offering 5,321 grocery items with an average discount of 20% to servicemen, veterans, and dependents

[3238] In order to support the care of military families and dependents, the MND has promulgated the "Enforcement Rules for Setting up Daycare Facilities and Services" and contracted with 391 legal, qualified and registered daycare centers to provide high-quality daycare services with preferential treatment to military dependents

[3239] In addition, a compact disk titled "Daycare Information" was distributed to troop units in September 2003 so as to implement services to military dependents

[3240] The MND will continually push ahead the initiative of the "Act of Welfare for Military Personnel" through legislative procedure so as to establish an operational mechanism to advance military welfare service

[3241] To meet the daily dietary requirements of the servicemen and their dependents, the MND introduced the "highly recommendable products of manufacturers" in the hope of offering the best-selling products as soon as they hit the private market

[3242] Meanwhile, “Complete Outsourcing of the Non-Staple Food Transportation” will benefit the servicemen by delivering the non-staple food directly to the troops, so that soldiers can concentrate on combat training with less distraction

[3243] Continuing the rebuilding of the Old Barracks In order to provide a safe and comfortable quality of life for servicemen, the MND allocates an annual budget to renovate, maintain and repair old barracks in accordance with the military buildup program and other operational requirements

[3244] Moreover, in order to take care of military dependents, the rebuilding of old barracks will combine with the construction of selective officer's quarters of the units

[3245] It is hoped that the voluntary officers and NCOs can look after their families while fulfilling their duties

[3246] Purchasing New Recreational Facilities To comply with the policy of e-government and to foresee the developmental trends of information and recreational facilities, the MND will combine the operational and daily requirements of servicemen and constantly acquire multimedia recreational devices for political education, and the “books for company or equivalent units”

[3247] Furthermore, fast and friendly services to the servicemen are assured through the internet, so that the living facilities of the troops can be improved and servicemen on duty can have peace of mind

[3248] Summary Major National Defense Policy Implementation (N) -Relations between the Military and the Public Protecting people's rights is an important part of improving relations between the military and the public

[3249] Seeing this, the Ministry of National Defense (MND) has not only continued to reduce military control zones, no construction zones and limited construction zones, but is also helping to protect people's legitimate rights through channels such as "appeals," the "Regulations of Compensation for Damages to the Public from Military Activities," and the "National Compensation Act

[3250] The ROC Armed Forces are closely connected to the society

[3251] To show this nature and to strengthen the nation's function of disaster relief, the MND has drawn up the disaster relief mechanism of the ROC Armed Forces and strengthened its manning and equipping

[3252] When there is a major disaster, the ROC Armed Forces will be obligated and be responsible to take the work of rescuing as a combat mission, doing our best to assist local governments on disaster relief so as to protect the safety of life and property of the people

[3253] To promote the transparency of national defense policy, the MND keeps close contacts with other government agencies and legislative bodies through government and military channels

[3254] The MND has also developed channels for releasing news that are used to explain every important national defense policies to the media and to the public in hopes of increasing communication and interaction between the military and society

[3255] Military units hold activities such as family reunions and social activities to help families of conscripts and the public understand servicemen's lives and training while in the military

[3256] To help Chinese people, at home and abroad, better understand the ROC Armed Forces' achievements in military buildup and combat readiness, further support the national defense, and deepen the good interactions between the ROC Armed Forces and the people, the military units will also arrange tours for families of conscripts and local people to attend large-scale military exercises and exhibitions, such as the Hanguang Exercise

[3257] Part 81 Major National Defense Policy Implementation (N) -Relations between the Military and the Public ■Protection of People's Rights To protect people's rights, the MND is not only gradually reducing military control zones, no construction zones and limited construction zones, but is also attempting to help people protect their rights through channels such as "appeals," the "Regulations of Compensation for Damages to the Public from Military Activities," and the "National Compensation Act

[3258] All cases are dealt with fairly and objectively

[3259] I. Military Control Zones, No Construction Zones, and Limited Construction Zones Responding to domestic political and economic changes, and complying with comprehensive national development, the MND has reviewed its land use and management policies and has begun to initiate several changes

[3260] For example, to reduce the number of military control zones, military zones with similar use are being combined so that they can now serve multiple purposes

[3261] The MND has also amended the "Vital Area Regulations" and the "Regulations on No Construction Zones and Limited Construction Zones" in a timely manner so that no construction zones and limited construction zones can be included in the National Comprehensive Development Plan, regional planning, and urban planning

[3262] No construction zones will be used as parks, green space, and parking lots in order to improve the efficiency of land use

[3263] Given the development of communities around military control zones, the height of buildings in limited construction zones will be restricted according to capacity ratio rather than the original military control zone restrictions in order to take people's rights into account and minimize negative influences

[3264] Reductions of Garrisons In accordance with the reduction and replacement of military facilities, weapons, and equipment, the MND has actively begun to reduce military garrisons through measures such as "elimination," "altering status as major military control zones," and "downsizing

[3265] In the past four years, a total area of 3,649.7 hectares has been released

[3266] Table 8-1 shows the results of garrison reductions

[3268] From 1998 to November 2004, 53 major military control zones were eliminated, and 98 were downsized

[3269] A total area of 14,544.4 hectares was reduced

[3270] Table 8-2 illustrates the reduction details

[3277] People's Right to Appeal

[3278] As stated in Article 16 of the Constitution of the ROC, people have the right of appeal

[3279] Its goal is to ensure that the executive branch operates according to law in order to safeguard people's rights

[3280] Policy and Current Situation The MND's "Petitions and Appeals Committee" is specifically responsible for people's appeals related to national defense affairs

[3281] If people think they have received administrative penalties that are inappropriate or illegal, they can appeal

[3282] The legitimacy and appropriateness of appeals will be investigated through appeal procedures

[3283] The goal of the policy is to ensure the enforcement of both servicemen's and people's rights

[3284] To guarantee the objectivity, impartiality, and reliability of investigations, the MND has issued the "Procedural Guidelines of Examination, Description and Debate for the Petitions and Appeals Committee," as the principle of the procedures to take care of cases of these kinds

[3285] The Petitions and Appeals Committee can have 5 to 15 members, according to the Law of Appeal and "the Regulations of the Organization of Petitions and Appeals Committee of the Executive Yuan and Other Level of Administrative Sectors

[3286] The MND's "Petitions and Appeals Committee" appointed 14 members in 2002, 15 in 2003 and 2004 respectively

[3287] Among them, two-thirds are scholars and experts from outside the MND, and the term of the committee members is one year

[3288] Another 5 committee members, including the chairperson, are senior staff (chief/ deputy chief from relevant units) of the MND

[3289] The membership of this group will be altered according to duty assignments

[3290] Among the 15 members, 13 are legal specialists

[3291] From July 2002 to November 2004, the MND completed 480 appeals, among which, 173 cases were dismissed, 166 not accepted, 59 retried, and 82 transferred or withdrawn

[3292] Table 8-3 is the table of statistics of appeal results

[3293] The results of appeals will be compiled and posted on the MND's website

[3294] Verdicts that reverse administrative penalties will be posted monthly in the MND's public announcements for reference

[3295] The MND will improve its data management, so that more information and searching options can be provided

[3296] All appeal verdicts from the years 2002 and 2003 were compiled and sent to organizations of the MND for future reference

[3297] In order to assist the MND's relevant units and organizations to process people's application of appeal or appeals, putting the idea of making the law as the priority into practice, on June 27, 2003, the MND held the "MND Appeal Practices Seminar

[3298] The seminar was a great success with approximately 350 participants from all the relevant units and organizations

[3299] On July 23, 2003, the MND reissued the order, emphasizing and requesting that all its units follow the "Administrative Procedure Law" while dealing with people's appeals or appeal applications

[3300] Administrative penalties should only be imposed by responsible organizations, so that every case is processed according to relevant laws and people's trust in the MND can be developed

[3310] National Compensation Act

[3311] To realize the National Compensation Act and protect people's rights, the MND and General Headquarters (GHQ's) and HQs have established the "National Compensation Deliberative Committee" to deal with compensation applications to its relevant units

[3312] All applications are investigated according to relevant regulations, as is all compensation granted

[3313] From July 2002 to November 2004, the MND accepted 53 new compensation applications and was still investigating 12 applications from last year

[3317] From the aspect of all-out defense, earning people's support and making the best use of people's specialties are two essential elements

[3318] From the aspect of development of the nation and society, the human and material resources of the ROC Armed Forces are significant to social support, to lower the damages of disasters and epidemics to the minimum, as long as battle training is not affected

[3319] Therefore, interactions and exchanges of information between the public and the ROC Armed Forces will improve their relations and people's approval, and thus enhance the nation's defense capability. Policy Planning All the manpower and resources of the ROC Armed Forces are from the society

[3320] Therefore, the ROC Armed Forces are obligated to be responsible to take disaster relief as operations and follow the instructions of the nation's disaster relief and rescue mechanism

[3321] Under the "Disaster Prevention and Response Act" and the "Regulations on Application for Disaster Relief and Rescue from the Military," the ROC Armed Forces dispatches its troops to assist disaster rescue and relief when major disasters happen

[3322] As long as relief and rescue activities do not disturb the ROC Armed Forces' combat readiness or hamper its command system, and are within its capabilities, the ROC Armed Forces will put in all their efforts to assist the work

[3323] Currently, the MND has included disaster relief into the ROC Armed Forces' missions so that they can participate in disaster relief and rescue as soon as possible to minimize casualties and people's property losses

[3324] The "Joint Operation Command Center of the ROC Armed Forces" (also functioning as "the command center for crises and contingencies managements") has servicemen on duty 24 hours a day

[3325] Under the guidance of the Disaster Response Center of the Executive Yuan, the Joint Operations Command Center is always ready for all kinds of emergencies and able to cooperate with the government's disaster response organizations

[3326] When emergencies occur, the Joint Operations Command Center immediately establishes a Command Center of Relief and Rescue (typhoon prevention) and allocates its resources such as servicemen, vehicles, and equipment to disaster areas for relief and rescue activities to secure the life and property of the people

[3327] Based on the concept of "all-dimensional security," in 2003 and 2004, the ROC Armed Forces have cooperated with other departments and ministries in the amendments of 29 laws and regulations, including "the Disaster Prevention and Response Act," "the Military Sector Nuclear Radiation Protection and Control Principles," and "the Disaster Prevention and Relief Plan of Storms, Floods, Droughts, Fires, Earthquakes, Forest Fires, and Land/Mud Slides

[3328] The MND will continue working with other administrative sectors to make out disaster relief and prevention plans, combining with all kinds of coping mechanisms such as mobilization, civil defense, medicine, anti-terrorism, disaster prevention and rescue, and nuclear accidents

[3329] The MND will also work together with other administrative sectors to refine the nation's capability in putting the "National Crisis Prevention and Coping Mechanism" into full practice

[3331] Exercise; with the Nantou County Government, Nangang Industrial Park Terrorist Toxic Gas Attack Exercise in Nantou County; with the Kaohsiung County Government, Dow Chemical Factory Anti-Terrorism Exercise in Kaohsiung County; with the Atomic Energy Council of the Executive Yuan, the He-an (nuclear safety) Exercise; with the Taipei City Government, Wan-an No. 26 and No. 27 All-Out Defense Exercise, including the City Administrative Center and High-risk Areas Alert, counter-hostage taking, bio-virus prevention, coping with bridge breaking; Homeland Security Protection Exercise, Tongsin No

[3336] Continuing to enhance the whole organization and structure of the "Armed Forces Disaster Relief and Rescue Mechanism

During the period of typhoon, the "Disaster Prevention/Relief and Response Coordination Center" of all General Headquarters (GHQs) and HQs transform into the supervision group, in order to make use of vehicles, machines/tools, and logistic support power for disaster relief and rescue

[3370] Epidemic Prevention The Armed Forces' epidemic prevention priorities are the insurance of servicemen's health and the sanitation of barracks

[3371] They also help local governments to prevent outbreaks of epidemic diseases by maintaining sanitation in local areas

[3372] Policy When natural disasters, such as typhoons, floods, and earthquakes occur, the ROC Armed Forces always try to prevent outbreaks of epidemic diseases in disaster areas

[3373] The Armed Forces evaluate the seriousness of disasters and send inspection groups to help disaster areas maintain sanitation

[3374] They also provide drinking water to both people and emergency personnel in disaster areas, advice for improving sanitation, disinfectant spray, transportation of sanitary equipment and material to assist epidemic prevention in disaster areas and to prevent outbreaks of epidemic diseases

[3375] Major National Defense Policy Implementation Relations between the Military and the Public Implementation Status Setting up the "New Infectious Diseases Monitor System" in the ROC Armed Forces hospitals in Kaohsiung, Zuoying, Taichung, Taoyuan, Songshan, and Hualien to support local epidemic monitoring

[3376] Coordinating with the Center for Disease Control (CDC) and conduct "Research on the Bacterial Rate in the Nose and Throat of Servicemen with Meningococcal Meningitis

[3377] Examinations are carried out randomly on new conscripts in the northern, central, southern, and eastern Basic Military Training Centers

[3378] The ROC Armed Forces endeavored to help epidemic prevention

[3379] Compiling information of HIV positive cases

[3380] The MND keeps track of volunteer officers and soldiers, giving them mental consultation and medical treatments

[3381] For those who are exempted from induction and who are suspended from active service, the MND has not only compiled and sent their information to the CDC, but also informed health agencies in the patients' areas of residence

[3382] The CDC and the MND's Medical Affairs Bureau check reported TB cases, send results to the medical centers of infected patients' service units, and keep track of the cases every month

[3383] Armed Forces Hospitals under the MND and the Institute of Preventive Medicine in the National Defense Medical College (NDMC) of National Defense University are military backups when epidemic diseases occur in troops

[3384] All the Armed Forces Hospitals provide medical treatment to patients, when suspicious symptoms are detected, and immediately inform health organizations, and the MND's Medical Affairs Bureau

[3385] The Institute of Preventive Medicine in the NDMC has P3 and P4 laboratories, which are most suitable for the monitoring, investigation, inspection, management, and study of epidemic diseases

[3386] Prevention and Control of SARS

[3387] During the first half of 2003, after the establishment of the Executive Yuan Epidemic Prevention and Difficulty Releasing Committee, the MND was in charge of affairs of national defense resources

[3388] It provided equipment and materials necessary for quarantine or medical treatment, disease prevention and manpower support, epidemic monitor in troops, and other support related to national defense resources

[3389] The MND enacted the "Guidelines for SARS Prevention in the Military," which stated response levels and regulations of relevant procedures for all units to follow in order to prevent the spread of disease among troops

[3390] c. Five Armed Forces Hospitals were appointed as SARS referral hospitals, which accepted and treated SARS patients

[3391] They are the Songshan Armed Forces Hospital in northern Taiwan; Zhongcing Branch, Taichung Armed Forces General Hospital in central Taiwan; the Tainan Armed Forces Hospital and Pingtung Branch of the Kaohsiung Armed Forces General Hospital in southern Taiwan; and Taitung Branch, Hualien Armed Forces General Hospital in eastern Taiwan

[3392] Five barracks were provided to local governments for quarantine use and 1,334 personnel were sent there

[3393] They were Hongwu Barracks, Dapingding Barracks, Shaokang Barracks, Weiguang Barracks, and Wangliaonan Barracks

[3394] e. Three barracks were provided for accommodating vagrants, and 268 vagrants were accommodated

[3395] They were Wugang Barracks in Taipei City, Houkengtai Barracks in Taipei County, and Jhongli Chiding Barracks in Taoyuan County

[3396] f. Providing disinfection assistance

[3397] The MND sent 32,809 chemical soldiers, engineering soldiers, Military Police, and Health Service Troops, 1,077 vehicles, and 6,339 various kinds of disinfection equipment to hospitals, examination sites and 23 counties and cities to assist disinfection work

[3398] Producing masks and surgical gowns

[3399] The MND produced 4512958 masks, and 303,780 surgical gowns

[3400] h. Research on diagnostic and treatment methods

[3401] a) The Institute of Preventive Medicine developed the RT-PCR diagnostic method, which could quickly and accurately diagnose whether a suspected case was infected

[3402] b) Blood plasma from recovering SARS patients was used to conduct in vitro anti-virus experiments, and studied the possibility of developing and producing blood plasma

[3403] c) The Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology invented a "Thermal Imaging Sensor," which could detect people's body temperature within a short time

[3404] During the period of the SARS outbreak, several Thermal Imaging Sensors were put in the Legislative Yuan, the Taipei Songshan Airport, and the CKS International Airport, which greatly improved the accuracy and efficiency of temperature taking

[3405] i. Controlling the epidemic in the Armed Forces

[3406] During the outbreak of the epidemic, there were 10 probable cases in the Armed Forces, of which 5 were eliminated and 5 were on the control list later; 102 suspected cases, of which 58 were eliminated, 44 were on the control list later; and 498 were in home quarantine

[3407] The total number of personnel on the control list was 547 people

[3408] Fourteen medical personnel of the Armed Forces hospitals were hospitalized due to taking care of SARS patients

[3409] No deaths and no in-hospital or in-barracks transmission occurred in the Armed Forces

[3410] SARS Response Measures During the Flu Season To cope with the SARS epidemic, the ROC Armed Forces developed the Thermal Imaging Sensor System

[3411] a. Giving vaccinations

[3412] Medical personnel of Armed Forces hospitals were given vaccinations

[3413] Moreover, in September and October 2003, more than 13,600 doses of vaccines were given to medical, cooking personnel, as well as aircrew

[3414] In 2004, the MND bought 6,000 doses of vaccines and gave them to servicemen who worked in closed operational environments

[3415] b. Mapping out the epidemic response procedure

[3416] In September 2003, the MND enacted the "SARS Response Procedures," which defined three response levels, "Alert, Monitor, and Responsive," and their response measures

[3417] The MND also promoted policies formulated by the Department of Health, namely, the "Individual Health Management and Quarantine Policy," "How to Deal with People Who Develop a Fever," and "No Signs of a Fever, No Worry of Transmission and No Need of Quarantine

[3418] Meanwhile, the MND requested that Armed Forces hospitals formulate standard procedures for in-hospital epidemic control as well as improving the personnel training

[3423] The MND has requested that all servicemen take their temperatures before entering barracks and has continued to monitor servicemen who have fever in all units

[3424] Strictly controlling the use and distribution of medicines and materials such as surgical gowns and masks used in epidemic prevention and control

[3425] Improving the knowledge about avian flu among servicemen and their families

[3427] The MND also works together with the police system, establishing the fully charged capability of "crisis warning" and deepening the firm foundation of "countering terrorism and responding to contingency" so as to maintain the stability of the society and the security of the nation

[3433] Environmental Protection Environmental protection is regarded as one of the ROC Armed Forces' obligations, so the ROC Armed Forces not only comply with but also implement national environmental policies, such as "Improving Pollution Prevention," "Protecting the Environment and Ecosystems," and "Sustainable Development of the Environment

[3434] Environmental policies are carried out according to regulations promulgated by the competent central authority

[3435] a. To properly dispose of waste materials, the Armed Forces' waste disposal is outsourced to local environmental protection agencies or eligible disposal companies approved by the Environmental Protection Administration (EPA

[3436] All waste is divided, listed, outsourced, tracked, and reported actively, so that pollution generated from disposal treatment will be minimized

[3438] The Armed Forces sent 1,934 servicemen, disposed of 176 metric tons of trash, eliminated the vector of dengue viruses, and helped clean the environment

[3439] Responding to the EPA's "Restricted Use Policy on Plastic Shopping Bags and Disposable Plastic Tableware," the Armed Forces promulgated a supervision and examination plan and formed supervision groups who conducted random inspections in all ROC Armed Forces units, and made sure the policy was thoroughly carried out

[3440] The Armed Forces also continue to promote the policy, "Recycling in Military Agencies

[3441] Domestic waste and waste from manufacturing process were reduced or recycled to improve the effectiveness of the policy

[3442] Water Pollution Control a. Complying with national environmental policies, the ROC Armed Forces completed the construction of 61 wastewater-processing facilities in its hospitals, factories, ports, and logistic maintenance agencies

[3443] The facilities process domestic and industrial wastewater from all military units to protect natural water

[3448] Airport Noise Control The ROC Armed Forces try their best to prevent airbase noise

[3452] The MND has formulated the "Regulations of MND's Subsidies to County or City Governments for Improving Aircraft Noise Control

[3453] The draft has been submitted to the Executive Yuan for review and will be a reference for local governments' application for subsidies to improve facilities for aircraft noise control

[3467] I. Coordination with the Government According to the "National Defense Act," the MND is in charge of overall national defense affairs and formulates military strategies

[3468] To ensure that national defense policies are implemented smoothly, the MND interacts with the President's Office, the Executive Yuan, and the Legislative Yuan through means such as meetings and briefs, supervision, investigations, and reports

[3469] Coordination Measures with the President's Office and the Executive Yuan Reporting on important military issues: The MND provides military reports to the President on issues such as far-reaching and long-term national defense policies, armament procurement programs, readiness and training, and important regulations so that the military and government administrations are compatible with each other

[3470] Coordination with the Executive Yuan: The MND attends cabinet meetings, complies with the national administration, and proposes relevant national defense bills

[3471] The MND also attends meetings of policy review and special reports held by the Council for Economic Planning and Development, the Mainland Affairs Council, Post-921 Earthquake Reconstruction Council, and the Council of Disaster Prevention

[3472] Dealing with appeals: The MND deals with people's appeals (including e-mail appeals) to the President, the Premier, and the Minister of Defense

[3473] From July 2002 to November 2004, the MND received 14,379 appeals, of which, 10,960 were rights protection cases, accounted for 76.22%; 311 were legal consulting cases, accounted for 2.16%; 543 cases were suggestions for improvement, accounted for 3.78%; 488 cases were reports on violations or mistakes, accounted for 3.40%; 2,077 other cases, accounted for 14.44%

[3474] All cases were dealt with within a limited time, and received official replies

[3475] In 2003, the MND conducted a satisfaction survey on appeal management

[3476] A total of 16,948 valid responses were collected, of which, 13,697 interviewees expressed satisfaction, and only 128 expressed dissatisfaction

[3477] The survey showed that the public appreciated the MND and its units' appeal management

[3503] The MND has taken all the corrective suggestions seriously and made rectification

[3504] It is absolutely normal for the people of a democratic nation to monitor its national defense affairs in a nation of democracy

[3505] As a result, the MND goes with the trend, keeps the policy of "transparent national defense" to fulfill "people's right of knowing

[3506] As long as military secrets are kept, the MND explains its policy and communicates with the public through its press release channels, so that people can understand national defense policy, develop a national defense consensus, and support the ROC Armed Forces

[3507] Press Release Policy The goal of the current policy follows four guidelines: • To protect the nation's security and national defense interests; • To develop an all-out defense consensus and a good relationship with the public; •

[3508] To make it compatible to the government and the national defense policies; To fulfill the military missions and current tasks

[3509] The MND also maintains good interactions and communications with the media, so that the media will help us promote national defense policies, and the public will have accurate information about national defense affairs and support military buildup and preparedness

[3510] Press Management Mechanism Military spokesmen are important channels between the military and the media

[3511] Spokesmen of units of various echelons are as the follows

[3512] The MND has its own spokesmen who make public announcement on behalf of the Ministry

[3513] Deputy Director for Cultural Affairs, the Political Warfare Department, is the spokesman of GHQs/HQs

[3514] Director of the Political Warfare Department (Executive Director) is the spokesman of the Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology, and military academies and hospitals, which are subordinates of the MND

[3515] Director of the Political Warfare Department is authorized by the GHQs/HQs as the spokesman of Army and Army Corps equivalent units

[3516] Chief judges or senior judges are designated as the spokesmen for Military Courts of all levels

[3517] Comments relevant to military lawsuits are only made by senior military judges or chief judges who are in charge of the cases

[3518] Designated head prosecutor or senior prosecutor are the spokesmen of Military Prosecutors' Offices of all levels

[3519] Spokesmen speak on behalf of their units and are in charge of their units' press release management and education

[3520] When there is important news to release, spokesmen will hold a press conference or appoint relevant personnel to speak for their units

[3521] Press Release Principles Seeing that national defense policy has far-reaching influences to society in terms of people's rights, obligations, security, and welfare, the MND is active and responsive in helping the public to understand national defense policy

[3522] The MND deals with issues that the public is concerned about carefully and comprehensively in a timely manner and with an "active, immediate, and open" attitude

[3523] The MND communicates with the public, clarifies misunderstandings, and refutes rumors immediately so that negative effects will not grow and spread and the ROC Armed Forces can maintain a good public image

[3524] The military press release principles are as follows: Constant Contacts and Instant Communication The ROC Armed Forces have established a channel to communicate with the media

[3525] Through the channel, the Armed Forces accept interviews, information request, and provide relevant information

[3526] In addition, the Armed Forces hold regular and irregular press conferences, news releases, and invite the media to all kinds of visits

[3527] As long as confidential information is kept, the Armed Forces are active in providing information and promoting communication so that the public is aware of the achievement of military preparedness and policy implementation so as to enhance the consensus of an "all-out defense

[3528] Collecting News Commentaries and Carefully Dealing with Them In response to people's expectations to national defense administration and help people better understand national defense policy, all units collect, follow, and understand military-relevant news and commentaries from mass media such as the press, electronic media, and the Internet

[3529] As long as there is an issue that involves people's rights and obligations or draws the public's attention, the ROC Armed Forces will communicate with the public openly to eliminate doubts

[3530] The MND also actively uses its authority to help people resolve their problems so that people's rights are fully guaranteed

[3531] Clarifying False News Timing is the key factor of news response

[3532] If false news is spread, they can severely damage the ROC Armed Forces' images and negatively influence the country

[3533] As a result, the ROC Armed Forces request that units at all levels take false reports seriously and deal with them open-mindedly

[3534] When dealing with false reports, all units should follow the "Regulations on Dealing with False News," find out the truth, and clarify the reports as soon as possible, so that the public knows the truth

[3535] Improving the News Release of Military Exercises The ROC Armed Forces improve the release of news on military exercises to help the public understand and support national defense affairs

[3536] The public always pays great attention to the military exercises, so the MND always thoroughly plans and prepares news releases before the exercises

[3537] The MND releases news on military exercises through tour visits, news conferences, or press releases to explain the goals, features, and background knowledge of the exercises, and to provide accurate and sufficient information to the media

[3538] With professional reports from the media, the MND hopes that the press release will be more efficient and effective and people will recognize and support national defense

[3539] News Release and Response a. News releasing News release issues include the enemy's situation and national defense affairs such as military personnel, intelligence, operation plans, logistics, communication and information, political warfare, human and other resources, regulations, armament, accounting, military laws, and military medical affairs

[3540] From July 2002 to November 2004, the ROC Armed Forces released 372 pieces of news

[3541] Reference data and press releases were faxed or emailed to journalists and posted on the MND's website for reference

[3542] The measures have greatly improved people's knowledge of national defense affairs

[3543] b. News response News response is a part of the ROC Armed Forces' news management

[3544] All units are willing to provide the media with relevant information and are not evasive in answering questions, but take news release opportunities to promote national defense policies and outstanding achievements

[3545] False news is dealt with immediately, so the ROC Armed Forces' images are well maintained

[3546] From July 2002 to November 2004, the Armed Forces gave 3,528 news responses

[3547] Regular News Briefings Every Tuesday morning, the MND holds briefings, hosted by the military spokesman, to explain significant national defense issues and to update the focus of media attention

[3548] Chief authorities of the MND and GHQs/HQs are invited to the briefings and respond to the media's questions so that the public knows the latest defense policies and the achievements of military buildup and preparedness

[3549] From July 2002 to November 2004, the MND gave 3,528 news responses

[3550] Media Interviews

[3551] To have people's confidence in military preparedness and support for military training and operations, the ROC Armed Forces give live event interviews to journalists by schedule or by event

[3552] The MND or its GHQs/HQs invites reporters to visit its units and report on important military exercises, mobilization and recall drill, the R&D of weapons, exhibition of training results, important celebrations, and commendations to outstanding units and servicemen

[3553] From July 2002 to November 2004 the military invited both domestic and foreign journalists to visit its units 62 times

[3554] Following are some of the interviews given to the media: Tour visit to the annual military model units

[3555] • Tour visit to military academies

[3556] • National defense resource outsourcing presentation

[3557] • Presidential inspections of military units

[3558] • Military epidemic contingency for SARS and the re-opening ceremony of the ROC Armed Forces Songshan Hospital

[3559] The activation ceremony of the CH-47SD Transport Helicopter Battalion of Army Aviation and Special Operation Command. Anti-terrorism drill at the Sixth Naphtha Cracker Plant in Yunlin County

[3560] The Hanguang No. 19 Joint Military Exercise

[3561] • Joint graduation ceremony of basic training corps for new cadets of Armed Forces Academies and female military instructors

[3562] • Military education training review conference

[3563] • On-line national defense knowledge challenge and prize award event

[3564] • Weapon system demonstration

[3565] • Groundbreaking ceremony of the Pohai Construction Program. •

[3566] The upgraded combat readiness level during the Chinese New Year

[3567] Through the media's reports, people have better awareness of the solid training and substantial achievements in the ROC Armed Forces

[3568] Communication with the Media

[3569] The ROC Armed Forces keep close contact and enhance coordination with military journalists through phone calls, visits, interviews, and provision of information

[3570] With friendly interactions, effective news responses, the media and the military maintain great relations and create a win-win situation for both

[3571] The ROC Armed Forces also keep close contact with managers of the media and hosts of political talk shows

[3572] Through presentations of defense policies and exchange of opinions, both have developed great friendship and reached a consensus on issues relevant to national defense

[3573] When there is an important defense policy to announce, the MND will explain the policy to the media through thorough presentations

[3574] In this way, the MND hopes people will receive complete information and support the policy

[3575] To Carry out the Concept of Image Marketing The MND is improving its news management by adopting more flexible measures in hopes of eliminating the impression of being conservative and passive and showing its achievement in military buildup and policy implementation

[3576] The MND hopes that with better understanding of the defense policy, the nation can reach an all-out defense consensus and people will support national defense affairs

[3577] To Have a Better Consistent News Release System The Joint Staff and GHQs/HQs are improving their common news release system in order to have more flexible command and smoother coordination so that they can meet the needs of news release and enhance risk management

[3578] Meanwhile, with the aim of news report consistency in both peace and wartime, the ROC Armed Forces put great efforts to ensure the news mechanism meets operational requirements and future development of media warfare

[3579] To Improve the Efficiency of News Mechanism A successful news mechanism foresees risks and responses in a timely manner

[3580] Therefore, the MND requests that all units have an "around the clock" news management concept

[3581] All units should always be ready to deal with military relevant news and clarify false news and reports that hamper the ROC Armed Forces' image and morale

[3582] To Enhance Communication with the Media The media serves as a bridge between the ROC Armed Forces and the public and a driving force pushing the ROC Armed Forces' progress, so we will keep working closely with the media

[3583] To earn the media's support and trust in the ROC Armed Forces so as to create a win-win situation for both, the MND asks all units to be active, friendly and willing to communicate with the media

[3584] Major National Defense Policy Implementation -Relations between the Military and the Public

[3585] Activities between the Military and the Public To promote the morale and solidarity of the ROC Armed Forces and to enhance the relations between the military and the public, troops of all levels hold social activities and provide assistance to the dependents of the military personnel

[3586] Through various exchanges and communications, the ROC Armed Forces show their respects to the rule of laws, dedication to training, and efforts on sound troop management

[3587] Leaders are requested to know and understand their superiors and subordinates, and deal with various issues sincerely and pragmatically

[3588] Efforts are also made to promote dependent assistance in the hopes of reducing concerns

[3589] Outstanding servicemen are selected as models

[3590] Our goal is to have a stable internal management, so that potential danger can be eliminated

[3591] In addition to the above measures, the ROC Armed Forces also hold various exhibitions and activities to show their achievements in military buildup and preparedness

[3592] We hope to win people's recognition and support through these activities

[3593] Implementation Status Troop Exhibitions

[3594] In order to show achievements in military buildup and preparedness and to earn the public's support, the ROC Armed Forces are active in interacting with the public and helping the public understand military training and national defense missions

[3595] The Armed Forces hope to solidify an all-out national defense consensus through the interactions and exhibitions

[3596] Military exhibitions are planned by basic military training camps (BMTC), military education units, and troops on Taiwan proper and offshore islands

[3597] All units hold exhibitions according to their respective tasks, special festivals, celebrations, weapon demonstrations, and military exercises (such as Hanguang Exercise

[3598] Except for the Hanguang Exercise, the Ciaotai Exercise, and weapon demonstrations, activities such as barrack tours, exhibitions of training results, and other social activities are organized by barracks

[3599] To help the public easily understand military training achievements and have confidence in the Armed Forces, all activities are safe, interesting, and easy to understand

[3600] From July 2002 to November 2004, troops of all levels held 56 large-scale troop exhibitions, and barracks opening tours (13 were held by the Army, 26 by the Navy, 11 by the Air Force [including air show in Taoyuan County], 4 by the Military Police, and 2 Joint Military Exercises

[3601] These activities greatly strengthened relations between the military and the public

[3602] Family Reunions and Social Activities To improve interactions and relations between the ROC Armed Forces and the public, barracks are opened for special activities on special festivals and celebration days

[3603] Troops of all levels invite families of conscripts, heads of local governments and conscription agencies to attend family reunion or social activities

[3604] Through these activities, families of conscripts understand servicemen's lives in the military

[3605] During 2003 and 2004, the ROC Armed Forces held 4,882 activities and more than 450,000 family dependents attended the activities

[3606] Dependent Assistance To help dependents of conscripts resolve problems, the Armed Forces provides family dependents with services such as “Paying Visits to Dependents,” “Contacting Services,” “Conscript Counseling,” “Dispute Settlement” through agencies such as Friends of the ROC Armed Forces Association and Military Service Centers in local areas

[3607] The Armed Forces also helped to establish the "Service Center for the ROC Armed Forces

[3608] The Service Centers provide servicemen and their dependents with counseling relevant to their rights and obligations

[3609] These services are meant to stabilize servicemen's emotions, solidify the public's support of the Armed Forces, and to increase servicemen's morale

[3610] From July 2002 to November 2004, the ROC Armed Forces provided assistance to 120,672 conscript families

[3611] Model Selection To establish a civilian-friendly image and encourage civilian-friendly actions, and military-supportive efforts so as to promote ethics and morale, and a great social ethos

[3612] Model promotion not only helps to stabilize society but also boosts relations between the ROC Armed Forces and civilians

[3613] Good People and Exemplary Deeds Award": The MND has established the "Guidelines for Nominating Good People and Exemplary Deeds

[3614] Every July, field units recommend and select qualified personnel, who are recommended to the national preparatory committee of the "Good People and Exemplary Deeds Award

[3615] Candidates who win the honor receive the award in December

[3616] b. Civilian-Friendly Model Selection

[3617] According to the Guidelines of Civilian-Friendly Model Selection, the award is given to both Civilian-Friendly units and Civilian-Friendly individuals

[3618] Candidates are recommended by field units from lower to higher units

[3619] After the MND's final review, GHQs/HQs will hold the award ceremony on Armed Forces Day (September 3) together with other celebrations

[3620] When selecting candidates, all units follow the guidelines rigorously

[3621] Candidates' deeds are reviewed from lower to higher units, and field units have the privilege of nominating candidates prior to other units

[3622] c. Military Support Model Selection: To recognize civilians or organizations who support military affairs, local import and export associations, civil societies such as the Taiwan Entertainment Union, and local service centers for servicemen, nominate candidates for the Military Support Model award

[3623] After the MND's review of the candidates' deeds, the MND holds an award ceremony on Armed Forces Day to honor the models

[3624] In year 2002 and 2003, a total of 57 people received the award

[3625] The ROC Armed Forces open barracks to show the results of military training

[3626] Military Artifact Exhibitions

[3627] In order to help the public better understand the history of the ROC Armed Forces, the MND has reorganized exhibitions in the "Armed Forces Museum" to show the history of the ROC Armed Forces and the patriotism of military heroes

[3628] Exhibitions are divided into regular exhibitions and special exhibitions

[3629] Regular exhibitions include "From the Founding of the Huang Pu (Whampoa) Academy to the Northward Expedition and a unified China," "The War of Resistance against Japan," "The Wars of Rebellion Suppression and Confrontations with the Communists," "The Modern ROC Military," "Arms Exhibition Room," and the "Military Ranks Exhibition Room

[3630] Special exhibitions are held according to special celebrations, festivals and important military exercises

[3631] From July 2002 to November 2004, the museum held the following special exhibitions, "Exhibition of Emblems," "Campaigns Oil Painting Exhibition," "Special Exhibition on the History of the Air Rescue Group, ROCAF," "Special Exhibition on the History of Goodwill Cruising Squadron," "Military History: 80 Years Since Huang Pu (Whampoa)," and the "Special Exhibition on the 40th Armed Golden Statues Awards for Literature and Art

[3632] Military artifacts exhibitions show the glorious history of the ROC Armed Forces

[3633] Enhance Model Personnel Models elected by the ROC Armed Forces should be included in civilian-friendly education and leadership seminars

[3634] The model's deeds shall be reported by the media so as to strengthen the ROC Armed Forces' civilian-friendly images, encourage good interactions, and win people's support

[3635] Expand Dependent Services To expand results of social events and dependent services, the ROC Armed Forces reinforce their event promotion through advertising channels to gain more popularity and participation from servicemen and their families

[3636] The ROC Armed Forces also hold various seminars to help troops and service families have better mutual communication so as to develop solidarity in troops

[3637] The National Defense Report is regarded as the Ministry's most important publication

[3638] Published periodically, and are based on the latest developments in defense affairs, such reports always attract great attention from the general public

[3639] The compilation of the 2004 National Defense Report took about one and a half years, from July 2003 to the end of

[3640] To present a comprehensive, complete, professional, and inclusive report, the Ministry invited more than thirty scholars to provide expert opinions

[3641] Members of the MND staff units, the National Defense University, and Fu Hsing Kang College were organized into various writing and editorial groups

[3642] The theme of this Report is on preventive defense and builds on this to illustrate the ROC Armed Forces' military readiness and efforts to safeguard our national territory

[3643] To compile this Report, the Ministry set up a writing/editorial task group, which consulted scholars and specialists for suggestions and reference

[3644] Staff units from the MND collected information and drew up a preliminary draft, which went through a cross-examination and review process before being finalized

[3645] Every subject was given the most detailed explanation, unless prohibited by military confidentiality

[3646] The first draft was finished in June

[3647] In July 2004, the second phase of compilation began to make the wording consistent with the national security policies adopted by the National Security Council

[3648] The second review was to highlight the Ministry's forward-looking policy concepts, planning, and administration

[3649] Minister of National Defense Lee Jye convened and chaired a policy directive group, inviting more scholars and experts to provide a wealth of opinions

[3650] After streamlined coordination with related governmental agencies and scholars, the Report was finalized under the supervision of Deputy Minister of National Defense Michael M. Tsai

[3651] The Report came into being through two editorial stages that enriched the content and improved readability with greater value for reference

[3652] Close coordination with other government agencies shows an intra-governmental consensus on national security and an integrated spirit of government administration

[3653] Greater transparency in defense affairs can be demonstrated by more extensive and in-depth accounts of current national defense policies and military strategies than previous reports

[3654] Finally, the change to horizontal Chinese typesetting makes the publication more lively and easier to read

[3655] This Report is a collective effort, a brilliant brainchild of all the staff of the MND and consultants

[3656] It is hoped that the Report is of great academic value for its richness in substance and vivid presentation and that readers will be able to gain more knowledge about national defense

[3657] Also, a transparent report like this aims at developing a consensus on national defense

[3658] In conclusion, the Report highlights the unselfish commitment and devotion of the ROC Armed Forces

[3659] Future publication of the "National Defense Report" needs the encouragement of all citizens

[3660] The Report will continue to serve as a roadmap to understand national defense and demonstrate the ROC Armed Forces' commitment to safeguarding the nation
